target: Homepage daily signals and proof path

contract.purpose: Help a reader scan today's independently supported signals and open the proof.
contract.canonicalPurpose: High Signal turns public evidence across technology, startups, and finance into one concise Daily Brief whose claims have independent support and click-through proof.
contract.audience: Founders, operators, and researchers filtering noisy public information.
contract.job: See whether any verified signal shipped today or yesterday, then open its proof page.
contract.thesis: One calm signal ledger; input feeds stay backstage.
contract.system: Preserve the existing Evidence Terminal typography, rules, spacing, and restrained cyan accent.
contract.signature: The claim-to-proof path: headline, change, consequence, uncertainty, and citations.
contract.risk: A quiet day can look sparse; that is accepted because cite-or-kill matters more than feed fullness.

projectCheck.command: web and API typecheck + web and targeted Biome checks + web production build + API brief suite + git diff --check

findings: Exact 390px, 768px, and 1440px browser captures have no horizontal overflow and preserve the evidence-ledger hierarchy.
Ten compact footer links failed touch-target checks; all footer navigation now clears 44 pixels and candidate accessibility is 100.

The invalid Agentmap robots directive and conflicting static robots file were replaced by one typed policy that keeps public and AI discovery surfaces crawlable while operator paths remain disallowed.

comprehension.reviewer: canonical purpose contract, live product data, and fresh exact-width browser review

answers.product: A concise Daily Brief built from public evidence across technology, startups, and finance.
answers.audience: Founders and operators who need decision-relevant changes without reading every feed.
answers.value: Fewer claims, each worth inspecting and easy to verify.
answers.mechanism: A claim ships only with an aligned primary source and independent corroboration.
answers.proof: The live first viewport exposes the current verified signal, its change, consequence, uncertainty, two sources, and direct-history state.
answers.nextAction: Open the current signal, switch to yesterday, or browse the chronological signal record.

accessibility.note: Footer navigation now exposes 44-pixel touch targets; candidate accessibility and target-size audits pass.
